description: Source code for a configuration loader module in the hookify plugin, handling parsing of markdown rule files with YAML frontmatter and defining data classes for rules and conditions.

classes.name: Condition
classes.description: Represents a single matching condition in a rule.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Represents a hookify rule with associated properties and methods for creation from dict.

methods.name: from_dict
methods.description: Creates a Condition or Rule object from a dictionary.

methods.name: extract_frontmatter
methods.description: Extracts YAML frontmatter and message body from markdown content.

methods.name: load_rules
methods.description: Loads all hookify rules from the .claude directory, optionally filtered by event.

methods.name: load_rule_file
methods.description: Loads a single rule file and returns a Rule object.
